'''''Gratiola officinalis''''', the '''gratiole''',<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |accessdate=2014-10-17 }}</ref> '''common hedgehyssop''', '''grace of God''',<ref>(Oxford English Dictionary)</ref> '''Gratia Dei''',<ref>(Oxford English Dictionary)</ref> '''hedge hyssop''',<ref>(Oxford English Dictionary)</ref> '''hedge-hyssop''',<ref>(Oxford English Dictionary)</ref> or '''herb of grace''', is an [[ornamental plant]] in the family [[Plantaginaceae]]. It is a [[rhizome|rhizomatous]] perennial herb native to Europe.<ref name=pow>[http://www.plantoftheweek.org/week317.shtml ''Gratiola officinalis''] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070813231826/http://www.plantoftheweek.org/week317.shtml |date=2007-08-13 }} Plant of the Week July 15–21, 2005.</ref>
